results.title: (World Cup) S. Korean defender Kim Tae-hyeon sidelined with ankle injury | Yonhap News Agency
highlights:
(World Cup) S. Korean defender Kim Tae-hyeon sidelined with ankle injury | Yonhap News Agency
[...]
ZAPOPAN, Mexico, June 10 (Yonhap) -- South Korean defender Kim Tae-hyeon hit the sidelines with an ankle injury Wednesday, the day before the country's first Group A match of the FIFA World Cup.
[...]
A national team official told reporters Kim hurt his ankle during a training session Tuesday at Chivas Verde Valle in Zapopan, near Guadalajara, and may miss the group stage.
[...]
South Korea will begin their tournament against Czechia on Thursday at Estadio Guadalajara. Their next match will be at the same venue against Mexico on June 18, and they will close out the group play against South Africa on June 24 in Monterrey, also in Mexico.
[...]
Kim skipped Wednesday's session at Chivas Verde Valle and did some individual workout indoors instead.
[...]
Kim, 25, is regarded as a backup at the center back position and the team official said South Korea will not select a replacement for the injured player.
[...]
"We have enough players who can play center back, like Lee Gi-hyuk and Cho Wi-je," the official said, listing two names that will likely get the start alongside veteran Kim Min-jae against Czechia. "Kim Tae-hyeon will continue to rehab his injury and we plan to use him in the round of 32 (if we get there)."
[...]
The official didn't entirely rule out the possibility that Kim Tae-hyeon will be available against South Africa in two weeks' time.
[...]
In another injury-related update, midfielder Bae Jun-ho is recovering from his own ankle injury and should be ready to play against Mexico next week, the team official said.
[...]
Bae suffered the injury on a hard tackle by a Trinidad and Tobago player during their friendly mach on May 30. He hasn't participated in a training session since and rode a stationary bike Wednesday.

results.title: 'At the worst possible time,' just one day before the World Cup, Hong Myung-bo's team faces a massive setback... Key center-back goes down. "Possible to miss all three group stage matches" [Report from Guadalajara] | STARNEWS
highlights:
# 'At the worst possible time,' just one day before the World Cup, Hong Myung-bo's team faces a massive setback... Key center-back goes down. "Possible to miss all three group stage matches" [Report from Guadalajara] | STARNEWS
[...]
A massive setback struck just before the World Cup's opening match. With the long-awaited Group Stage opener against Czech Republic approaching, the South Korean national football team faces an emergency: the sudden injury of starting center-back Kim Tae-hyun (Kashiwa Reysol) at the decisive venue.
[...]
Coach Hong Myung-bo and the Lee Kkeu-neun (CEO) team conducted their final training session on the 10th (local time) in the afternoon at the Chivas Verde Valle training ground near Guadalajara, Mexico, in preparation for the Czech Republic match.
[...]
The national team had initially been progressing smoothly through its training, but an unexpected crisis emerged when news of an injury sustained during tactical training the previous day was reported.
[...]
According to a South Korean Football Association official, Kim Tae-hyun injured his left ankle while participating in a so-called passing game round during training on the 9th. As a result, Kim Tae-hyun, along with Bae Jun-ho (Stoke City), who also injured his ankle during the Trinidad and Tobago match, faces difficulty in playing tomorrow's game.
[...]
Even more critically, Kim Tae-hyun's injury appears to be severe. He may miss all three Group Stage matches, including the opening game against Czech Republic, as well as the matches against Mexico and South Africa.
[...]
absence is a
[...]
With Kim Tae-hyun out of the lineup, it is now highly likely that Lee Ki-hyuk (Gangwon FC), who was the surprise selection as the left-footed center-back in Hong Myung-bo's three-man defense, will take his place. Lee Ki-hyuk, who emerged as a Cinderella story after his first selection under Hong Myung-bo, has recently demonstrated sharp passing in the final friendly matches against Trinidad and Tobago and El Salvador.
[...]
Hong Myung-bo's team had already lost Jo Yu-min (Sharjah) to injury, who had been included in the final roster for the friendly against Trinidad and Tobago. Among the team's professional center-backs are Kim Min-jae, Lee Han-beom, and Jo Wi-je (Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors), who joined as a training partner and was promoted to a full roster member in place of Jo Yu-min. Park Jin-seop (Zhejiang FC), who can play both as a defensive midfielder and a center-back, is currently classified as a defender.

results.title: South Korea's Defense Struggles as Kim Tae-hyun Out for Group Stage
highlights:
Key Defender's Ankle Injury Adds to Defensive Concerns Ahead of World Cup Opener
[...]
The South Korean national team’s final official training session before their first match of the 2026 North America World Cup was held one day before the Czech Republic game on the 11th (Korean time) at Chivas de Guadalajara’s Valle Verde training facility in Guadalajara, Mexico. During the session, which was open to the media for the first 15 minutes, defender Kim Tae-hyun (Kashima) was the only member of the squad not seen warming up.
[...]
According to a source from the national team, Kim Tae-hyun sustained an ankle injury during a fully closed-door training session the previous day and conducted individual reinforcement exercises alone in the indoor training facility on the day of the session. He reportedly twisted his left ankle while performing a "ronaldo" passing drill. Medical examinations revealed that Kim Tae-hyun is unlikely to participate in the three group-stage matches of this World Cup.
[...]
Under FIFA regulations, teams can replace injured players with other squad members up to 24 hours before the first World Cup match. However, the team decided not to replace Kim Tae-hyun, as it was judged that he would be able to play from the Round of 32 onwards.
[...]
The South Korean national team heading into this World Cup has been noted for its unstable defense as a weakness. This anxiety has grown further due to consecutive injuries to key defensive resources. Defender Kim Joo-sung (Hiroshima), who held significant importance in Hong Myung-bo’s team, did not make the final squad due to injury. Cho Yu-min (Sharjah) also left midway through a friendly match against Trinidad and Tobago in Salt Lake City, USA, last month after sustaining an injury.
[...]
With Kim Tae-hyun also injured, Lee Ki-hyuk (Gangwon) is likely to start as the left stopper in the three-back formation for the Czech Republic match. Lee impressed with his attacking contributions and accurate kicking in the Trinidad and Tobago match but struggled under pressure from El Salvador. There is also a possibility that Park Jin-seop (Jeonbuk) could be deployed instead. In that case, Park is expected to play as the central sweeper, with Kim Min-jae moving to the stopper position.
[...]
In addition to Kim Tae-hyun, second-line attacker Bae Joon-ho (Stoke City) is also expected to struggle to play in the Czech Republic match. Bae injured his ankle after a rough back tackle during the Trinidad and Tobago match. Since then, he has undergone separate recovery training and was seen cycling alone instead of joining the team training session a day before the Czech Republic match. Bae is expected to be available for the second match against Mexico.

results.title: Bae doubtful for South Korea as World Cup opener with Czech Republic looms | The Straits Times
highlights:
Bae doubtful for South Korea as World Cup opener with Czech Republic looms | The Straits Times
[...]
Bae doubtful for South Korea as World Cup opener with Czech Republic
[...]
June 9 - South Korea's Bae Jun-ho is unlikely to feature in his nation's World Cup opener against the Czech Republic in Guadalajara on Thursday as the midfielder continues to recover from an injury to his ankle sustained in a 5-0 win over Trinidad and Tobago 10 days ago.
[...]
The 22-year-old Stoke City playmaker missed his nation's 1-0 victory over El Salvador on Thursday and has trained on his own in an increasingly unlikely bid to be ready for South Korea's opening Group A clash against Miroslav Koubek's side.
[...]
Bae is one of the youngest players in coach Hong Myung-bo's squad and is expected to add a dash of youthful vigour to a line-up that laboured throughout Asia's preliminaries before securing their berth at an 11th consecutive World Cup.
[...]
Koubek will also lean on West Ham midfielder Tomas Soucek and 35-year-old Vladimir Darida -- who earned a recall to the national team after impressing for Hradec Kralove in the Czech top tier this season -- to provide experience and stability. REUTERS
